youtube_title: Jesus... Why Did I Stay Quiet When She Took My Credit? 😤 | Proverbs 15:1 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for stolen credit at work.

He: Jesus... my teammate read out my fix in the standup. My name wasn't said. 😤
He: I corrected her in my head the whole rest of the day.
Jesus: Anger at unfairness isn't the enemy. Silence that swallows it is.
He: If I speak up, I look petty. If I don't, my work walks away wearing her name.
Jesus: A gentle answer can still be a clear one. Clarity costs less than resentment.
Jesus: Say it once, calmly, in the room where it happened. That's enough.
Jesus: Have you ever had your credit taken? 👇
